title: TermsLens Expected Ground-Truth Outputs
description: Golden ground-truth reference benchmarks for test cases defined in test-cases.json.

schemaTemplate.testCaseId: Reference identifier matching testCaseId in test-cases.json

expectedCriteria.verbatimQuoteRequired: Exact verbatim excerpt that must be present in evidence.exactQuote
mandatoryPhrasing: Phrasing required when information is unstated (e.g., 'contains no mention of an opt-out window')
forbiddenAssertions: Specific unevidenced claims that must not be generated (e.g., 30-day deadlines, unmentioned data brokers)
requiredKeyPoints: Core plain-language explanations that must be communicated to the consumer

expectedCriteria.verbatimQuoteRequired: Your TermsLens Premium subscription will automatically renew at the end of each billing cycle unless you cancel it before the renewal date. By subscribing, you authorize us to charge your designated payment method recurring monthly fees.
requiredKeyPoints: Automatic subscription renewal at the end of each billing cycle
Authorization of recurring charges on user's payment method

expectedCriteria.verbatimQuoteRequired: All subscription payments are strictly non-refundable and no prorated refunds or credits are issued for partially used months.
requiredKeyPoints: No prorated refunds or credits for partial months

expectedCriteria.verbatimQuoteRequired: We do not sell your personal identifying information to data brokers. However, we may share pseudonymous browsing metrics, unique mobile advertising identifiers, and aggregated interaction logs with our third-party advertising partners for cross-context behavioral targeting.
requiredKeyPoints: Shares pseudonymous browsing metrics and ad identifiers with third-party ad partners

expectedCriteria.verbatimQuoteRequired: Any dispute, controversy, or claim arising out of or relating to this agreement shall be settled exclusively by confidential, binding arbitration administered by the American Arbitration Association under its Commercial Arbitration Rules. You expressly waive your constitutional right to a jury trial and agree that you may only bring claims against us in your individual capacity, and not as a plaintiff or class member in any class or representative proceeding.
requiredKeyPoints: Mandatory binding arbitration under AAA rules
Express waiver of right to jury trial and class action proceedings

expectedCriteria.verbatimQuoteRequired: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate your account and access to the Service at any time, immediately and without prior notice or liability, for any reason, including without limitation if you breach the Terms.
requiredKeyPoints: Right to terminate account immediately without prior notice or liability
